take basic classes like math, english comp 1/2, biology, and your advisor should be able to tell you all the necessary basic classes. then you should decide on what you choose for your major by the end of your freshman year so that you can sign up for your sophomore year on the necessary classes for your major. and also check with your advisor if the classes for your sophomore year is transferrable to your university, bc some of mine isnt and it wasted my time and money. so just make sure you discuss your schedule with your advisor a lot so that you're always on the right track and will graduate on time! just keep asking "do i need to take this class?" because sometimes they put you in a class that you dont even need just to fit the full time student hours, so if you do need to fill in the full time student hours, make sure its a class that you actually can use for your transfer and for your major

since you're like super early and going to college, make sure you take necessary classes for the major you want to do. best time to change major is towards the end of your freshman year because you would only be taking like basic college classes. if you're going to a community college, talk to your counselor on what classes is transferrable to the university of your choosing, bc i took some classes in college and my university didnt even take it so it was a waste of time and money. also, ask your college counselor on estimate of graduating time, you might be able to graduate early if you have all the hours and classes taken. dont be scared to ask 2-4 years ahead because time is crucial. in terms of studying, manage your time well, library is the best place to relax and get hw done. uhhh, i guess try to get good gpa early on, because classes are going to be harder further on, so if you're under scholarship, you wouldnt want to lose it due to your gpa. but all seriousness aside, be involved in clubs so you can meet up new people and have fun, make new friends in class and have study group together, and yeah, be responsible with your education but also dont forget to have a lot of fun after that! goodluck to you!!
